# PRATIMA AI

> PRATIMA AI (Connecting Dots) is an India-first engineering and intelligence agency connecting applied artificial intelligence, custom software systems, school & EdTech platforms, and AI CRM/LMS portals for organizations.
> Operating Motto: "One team owns the whole picture — not four vendors pointing fingers."

## Core Practices & Capabilities

- [Services](https://pratimaai.com/services): Overview of our 4 connected practices.
  - **AI Intelligence & Business Support**: Applied assistants, operational opportunity assessment, internal knowledge systems, and ongoing support.
  - **Software Solutions**: Custom web platforms, operational tools, and maintainable software architectures.
  - **Schools and EdTech**: Responsible AI education platforms that build teacher AI-fluency and institutional confidence.
  - **CRM & LMS Portals with AI Infrastructure**: Intelligent portals with embedded autonomous AI agents for customer operations and adaptive student workflows.
- [Work](https://pratimaai.com/work): System maps, platform deliveries, and real operational outcomes.
- [About](https://pratimaai.com/about): Leadership team and operating principles.
  - Leadership: Prashanth (CEO & Founder), Sanjeeva Reddy (CTO), Riya (CFO & HR), Varun (President), Sai Dhanush (Vice President).
  - Principles: Start with the work, Make the connection visible ("If a system can't explain its own answer, we don't consider it finished"), Build for operation, Keep people responsible.
- [Blog & Perspectives](https://pratimaai.com/blog): Editorial insights and open community views on AI architecture, software maintainability, and learning systems.
- [Contact](https://pratimaai.com/contact): Direct project inquiries and partnership discussions.
